description:
intent=i046 snapshot=s03 branch=hardirq-shared-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/staging/comedi/drivers/ni_pcidio.c:360-371 confidence=medium conclusion=ni_pcidio.c COMEDI_POLL ioctl path takes mite_channel_lock with plain spin_lock (368, nested under irqsave of a different lock) while hardirq nidio_interrupt (request_irq:946) takes the same lock plainly at 400; same-CPU IRQ preemption spins forever - medium-confidence interrupt-context lockup/DoS.
finding location=drivers/tty/synclink_gt.c:1161-1168 confidence=medium conclusion=synclink_gt.c compat ioctl set_params32 (MGSL_IOCSPARAMS32) takes info->lock with plain spin_lock at 1161 while hardirq slgt_interrupt (request_irq:3661) takes the same lock plainly at 2385; all sibling sites use irqsave - medium-confidence interrupt-context lockup/DoS.
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/korina.c:935-945 confidence=low conclusion=korina.c korina_tx (hardirq via tx DMA IRQ, plain spin_lock at 526) shares lp->lock with sibling plain hardirq takers korina_und_interrupt(935)/korina_ovr_interrupt(962); a same-CPU und/ovr IRQ preempting the enabled-IRQ tx handler spins forever - low-confidence nested-IRQ lockup.
unresolved location=drivers/tty/serial/zs.c:721 conclusion=Follow up: classify each zs.c plain zlock site (381-692) by caller context - if zs_set_mctrl/zs_stop_tx/zs_start_tx run with IRQs enabled from process context (e.g. via uart_ops not wrapped by serial_core's irqsave), the plain ISR taker at 721 is a reportable hardirq-shared-lock defect.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/lpc32xx_udc.c:2743 conclusion=Follow up: trace lpc32xx_udc.c done()/stop_activity()/lpc32xx_stop() call chains - if any runs in process context (gadget unbind, usb_gadget_disconnect) with plain spin_lock(&udc->lock) against the plain hardirq takers at 2743/2782/2824, it is a reportable mixed-discipline hardirq lockup.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/m66592-udc.c:1205 conclusion=Follow up: classify m66592-udc.c plain m66592->lock sites (99, 1000) by context; a process-context plain holder against the plain hardirq taker at 1205/1184 confirms a hardirq lockup defect.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/mv_u3d_core.c:1685 conclusion=Follow up: trace mv_u3d_core.c mv_u3d_done(219) callers - any process-context plain spin_lock(&u3d->lock) against the hardirq takers at 1685/1713 confirms the defect.
unresolved location=sound/pci/echoaudio/echoaudio.c:1828 conclusion=Follow up: read echoaudio.c around 754 to identify the enclosing mixer/pcm function and confirm it runs in process context with plain spin_lock(&chip->lock) against the plain hardirq taker at 1828; if so, this is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=sound/pci/korg1212/korg1212.c:1123 conclusion=Follow up: identify the enclosing function of korg1212.c line 1584 and its callers; a process-context plain acquisition of korg1212->lock against the hardirq taker at 1123 is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/renesas/ravb_main.c:790 conclusion=Follow up: map ravb_main.c interrupt dispatch (which handlers request_irq registers vs which are nested helpers) and check whether any non-hardirq path (NAPI poll, ethtool, open/close) takes priv->lock plainly against the plain taker at 790.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions textually (e.g. priv->lock vs dev->lock vs struct-name aliases), so locks shared across files via exported helpers or different naming could be missed.
coverage_gap=request_threaded_irq sites were not split into primary hardirq handler vs thread_fn; thread-context acquisitions of a lock also taken by a primary handler were not separately audited.
coverage_gap=Legacy s03 facts f003 (xmit-softirq), f019 (timer-dwork), f039 (tasklet-napi) were not systematically cross-consulted to prioritize files that already showed lock-discipline weakness in sibling branches.
